breaking_news.headline: Weddings are expensive. How about a grocery store cake?
breaking_news.summary: About a third of couples are willing to save money on cake and dessert, according to the wedding-planning site Zola.

breaking_news.headline: Noah Adams, longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, has died
breaking_news.summary: One of NPR's most gifted storytellers, his soft voice and vivid writing helped define the network's sound for a generation of Americans.

breaking_news.headline: Difficult times in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation of farmers
breaking_news.summary: Many farmers across the U.S. are reaching retirement age. But lately, increasing volatility and sky-high prices in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation to take over.

breaking_news.headline: TikTok staff raised child safety alarms. Court records show executives failed to act
breaking_news.summary: The warnings surfaced in a trove of unreported court records. "I have been fighting about fixing this for months with people who didn't think the harms are severe enough," wrote one executive.

breaking_news.headline: Why these 5 everyday items fluctuate in price at the grocery store
breaking_news.summary: Here's what's behind the fluctuating costs of everyday grocery items such as ground beef, eggs and chocolate chip cookies.

breaking_news.headline: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?
breaking_news.summary: Research on past recessions suggests downturns can accelerate automation. That raises the specter of a double whammy for workers.

breaking_news.headline: FAA clears the way for airlines to put Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 into service
breaking_news.summary: Nearly a decade after Boeing unveiled its largest 737 Max jet, the company has cleared a major hurdle in its effort to bring the plane to airlines.

breaking_news.headline: Netflix holds quarterly earnings call following leadership shakeup and layoffs
breaking_news.summary: Netflix reported its latest quarterly earnings on Tuesday. It comes as the streaming company has announced a management shakeup and layoffs of more than 1,000 employees.

breaking_news.headline: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
breaking_news.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.

breaking_news.headline: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
breaking_news.summary: The warning to US officials comes as at least three people die in the latest strikes at an airport and an oil field.

breaking_news.headline: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
breaking_news.summary: President Vladimir Putin does not feel under pressure right now to end the war, the BBC's Russia Editor writes.

breaking_news.headline: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
breaking_news.summary: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

breaking_news.headline: Governments working to identify exposure after global cyber-security warning
breaking_news.summary: Governments and companies are scrambling to protect their websites, as Amazon says it experienced attacks before the warning was made public.

breaking_news.headline: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
breaking_news.summary: Disaffection has often driven down turnout among Arab Israelis, but there is a strong push to get rid of the right-wing governing coalition.

breaking_news.headline: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
breaking_news.summary: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

breaking_news.headline: Airbnb hosts can no longer make guests strip beds and wash dishes under new rules
breaking_news.summary: The updated policy will apply to all reservations booked on the accommodation site on or after 20 November.

breaking_news.headline: The grads ditching the UK for a fresh start abroad
breaking_news.summary: With graduate jobs hard to come by, more young adults are reported to be considering emigrating.

breaking_news.headline: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
breaking_news.summary: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.

breaking_news.headline: No order, no seat: Starbucks China rolls out new store policy
breaking_news.summary: Starbucks says it is improving customers' in-store experience as it competes with homegrown rivals.

breaking_news.headline: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
breaking_news.summary: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.
